title: Employee CRUD API
request: Build a REST API for employee management with FastAPI and SQLite. Endpoints: POST /employees, GET /employees, GET /employees/{id}, PUT /employees/{id}, DELETE /employees/{id}. Fields: name, email, role, department. Include Pydantic validation, pytest tests, and README.

title: JWT Auth Layer
request: Add JWT authentication to a FastAPI employee API. Endpoints: POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login (returns JWT), GET /me (protected). Use python-jose and passlib, hash passwords, include tests for auth flow.

title: FastAPI Hello World with Tests
request: Create a minimal FastAPI service with GET / and GET /health, plus pytest tests that verify 200 status.

title: Task Management API
request: Build a task management REST API: Task has title, description, status (todo/doing/done), due_date. CRUD + filter by status. Add pagination (limit/offset) and tests.

title: Blog Posts API with Search
request: Build a blog posts API with FastAPI: POST /posts, GET /posts?search=, GET /posts/{id}. Post has title, content, author, tags. Add search filter and pytest.

title: Calculator Tool API
request: Build a calculator API: POST /calculate with {expression: string} evaluates safely, GET /history returns past calculations. Store in SQLite, add validation and tests.

title: User Registration with Validation
request: Build user registration: POST /users with email validation, password strength check (8+ chars, upper, number), duplicate check. Use Pydantic validators and tests.

title: Inventory CRUD with Stock Check
request: Inventory API: item has name, sku, quantity, price. CRUD + POST /items/{id}/adjust {delta}. Prevent negative stock, add tests.

title: Book Library API
request: Book library: POST /books, GET /books?author=&genre=, GET /books/{id}, DELETE. Book has title, author, genre, year, isbn. Add filtering and tests.

title: Notes API with Timestamps
request: Notes API: create, list, get, update, delete notes. Each note has title, content, created_at, updated_at auto-managed. Add tests verifying timestamps.

title: Contacts API with Pagination
request: Contacts CRUD with pagination and search by name/email. Contact has name, email, phone, company. Add validation for email/phone and tests.

title: Weather Mock API
request: Mock weather API: GET /weather/{city} returns {city, temp, condition} from in-memory store, POST /weather to add city. Add caching header and tests.

title: E-commerce Cart API
request: Cart API: products CRUD + cart operations: POST /cart/add, POST /cart/remove, GET /cart, POST /cart/checkout (calculates total). Include tests for checkout.

title: URL Shortener
request: URL shortener: POST /shorten {url} returns {short_code}, GET /{short_code} redirects (or returns url). Use 6-char codes, store mapping, add tests.

title: Feedback API with Rating
request: Feedback API: POST /feedback {user, rating 1-5, comment}, GET /feedback?min_rating=, GET /feedback/stats (avg rating). Add validation and tests.
